blocks.prompt: 6. The perimeter of a triangle is 16 cm. If one side is of length 6 cm, what are the lengths of the other sides for maximum area of the triangle.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh maximum area ka sawal hai, aur triangle ka area teeno sides se nikalne ke liye Heron's formula kaam aata hai.
Diya kya hai? Perimeter 16 cm aur aik side 6 cm, yani baqi do sides ka jama 10 cm.
Find kya karna hai? Baqi do sides kitni hon ke area sab se zyada ho.
Rule kaunsa? Heron's formula, aur square root se bachne ke liye \(A\) ki jagah \(A^{2}\) ko maximize karna.
Plan: sides \(x\) aur \(10 - x\) lenge, aur triangle inequality se \(x\) ki range bhi likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: perimeter 16 cm; aik side 6 cm.
Maloom karna: baqi do sides jin se area sab se zyada ho.
Tareeqa: Heron's formula \(A = \sqrt{s(s - a)(s - b)(s - c)}\), jahan \(s = \frac{a + b + c}{2}\) (semi-perimeter, yani aadha perimeter); \(A\) ki jagah \(A^{2}\) ko maximize karenge.

Variables aur ijazat wali values
Baqi sides: \(x\) aur \(10 - x\) (cm), kyun ke \(16 - 6 = 10\).
\[x < 6 + (10 - x) \Rightarrow x < 8\]
\[10 - x < 6 + x \Rightarrow x > 2\]
Kyun: triangle mein har side baqi do sides ke jame se chhoti hoti hai (triangle inequality); warna sides jur kar triangle banta hi nahi. Is liye \(2 < x < 8\).

Heron's formula se area
\[s = \dfrac{16}{2} = 8\]
\[A = \sqrt{8(8 - 6)(8 - x)(8 - (10 - x))}\]
\[A = 4\sqrt{(8 - x)(x - 2)}\]
Kyun: \(8 \times 2 = 16\) aur \(\sqrt{16} = 4\) bahar aa gaya; aur \(8 - 10 + x = x - 2\).
Dhyan dein: \(8 - (10 - x)\) mein bracket ka minus dono terms par lagta hai.

\(A^{2}\) ko maximize karein
\[f(x) = A^{2} = 16(8 - x)(x - 2)\]
\[= 16(-x^{2} + 10x - 16) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: area positive hai, aur positive numbers mein jo bara ho us ka square bhi bara hota hai. Is liye \(A\) aur \(A^{2}\) aik hi jagah sab se bare hain, aur \(A^{2}\) mein square root nahi, to derivative aasaan hai. (Example 33 mein \(D^{2}\) wali tarkeeb yaad kijiye.)

Critical point
\[f'(x) = 16(-2x + 10) \quad \text{...(2)}\]
\[-2x + 10 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 5\]
Kyun: \(x = 5\) range \(2 < x < 8\) ke andar hai, is liye qabool hai.

Second derivative test
\[f''(x) = -32 < 0\]
Kyun: negative hai, is liye \(x = 5\) par \(A^{2}\), aur is liye \(A\), maximum hai. Doosri side \(10 - 5 = 5\) cm.

Maximum area aur tasdeeq
\[A = 4\sqrt{(8 - 5)(5 - 2)} = 4\sqrt{9} = 12\text{ cm}^{2}\]
Tasdeeq: 5, 5, 6 wala triangle isosceles (do barabar sides wala) hai. 6 cm base par us ki oonchai \(\sqrt{5^{2} - 3^{2}} = 4\) cm hai (Pythagoras), is liye area \(\frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 4 = 12\text{ cm}^{2}\) ✓. Dono tareeqon se aik hi jawab.
blocks.final_answer: Baqi dono sides 5 cm ki hain (sides 5, 5, 6 wala isosceles triangle); maximum area \(12\text{ cm}^{2}\) hai.
